post.description: Replaces all modules of an existing branch (default: the branch active in the world) and marks the player active. Serialized `modules` over 5 MiB are rejected; module names starting with `$`, `.`, `/` or `\` are dropped; a `main` module is ensured. Missing branches yield `branch does not exist`. post.description: Queues a JavaScript expression for evaluation in the player's runtime on the given shard, with normal CPU accounting. The JSON-encoded expression must not exceed 1024 characters (`expression size is too large`). The official web client sends `expression` and the current `shard`.

post.description: Replaces the account's CPU allocation across shards (`Game.cpu.shardLimits`) with `cpu: {<shard>: limit}`. The new allocation is reflected in `GET /api/auth/me` (`cpuShard`, `cpuShardUpdatedTime`). Placing an initial spawn (`gamePlaceSpawn`) resets the allocation to the shard where the spawn was placed. The success body carries `ok: 1` plus database-driver metadata; only `ok` is stable.

200.description: Success, or a logical error in the HTTP 200 `{error}` envelope.

description.description: Name supplied when the token was generated.

steamTicket.description: Hex-encoded Steam session ticket sent by the official web client's Steam desktop build.

AuthSteamAccount.description: Linked Steam account data of the signed-in player.

ownership.description: Steam application IDs owned by the account; the official web client checks 464350 (game), 491760 (subscription) and 883940 (lifetime subscription).

steamProfileLinkHidden.description: 1 when the Steam profile link is hidden from other players (node-screeps-api types `0 | 1`; the official web client reads it as a boolean).

ticket.description: Hex-encoded Steam session ticket (`GetAuthSessionTicket`), or the encrypted app ticket when `useNativeAuth` is true.

useNativeAuth.description: Request Greenworks encrypted app-ticket verification instead of session-ticket verification.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

username.description: Account username; absent for new accounts, which the official web client then sends to username selection.

email.description: Account e-mail, read by the official web client for analytics on first sign-in.

list.description: The user's results in every season.

LeaderboardFindAllResponse.description: Results of all seasons (when `season` was omitted).

LeaderboardFindSeasonResponse.description: Result of one season (when `season` was given): the ranking fields at the top level.

count.description: Total ranked users in the season.

LeaderboardMode.description: `world`: control points upgraded (GCL) in the season; `power`: power processed (GPL).

LeaderboardResult.description: A user's ranking in one season.

rank.description: Zero-based position in the season ranking (the official web client computes the page as `floor(rank / 10) + 1`).

LeaderboardSeasonId.description: Monthly leaderboard season `YYYY-MM` (UTC); unrelated to Seasonal World competitions.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

seasons.description: Newest first; the first entry is the current season.

LeaderboardUser.description: Public user data of a listed result.

email.description: Optional e-mail stored lower-cased; must match the server e-mail rule.

recaptcha.description: reCAPTCHA response sent by the official web client.

tutorialDone.description: Whether the tutorial was completed before registration (sent by the official web client).
Whether the tutorial was completed before registration.

branches.description: Code branches edited before registration, as kept by the official web client.

length.description: Total players in the result set.

rank.description: Current season rank; ties appear broken alphabetically.

players.description: Nominal participant count; observed almost always 0.

rank.description: The caller's current ranking on the seasonal leaderboard.

list.description: Past, current and upcoming competitions by `index` ascending.

UserBadge.description: Player badge (`users.badge`) used to render the player icon.

type.description: Standard badge shape number, or the custom SVG path pair of a premium/custom badge.

param.description: Shape parameter; submissions are limited to -100..100. Absent on custom-path badges.

flip.description: Mirror/rotate the shape according to its flip rule.

decoration.description: Decoration id of a non-standard badge (node-screeps-api type).

UserBadgeColor.description: Badge color. Submitted badges use `#rrggbb`; stored legacy badges may contain an integer index into the badge palette, which the official web client converts through its color table.

UserBadgeCustomPaths.description: Pair of SVG path strings composing a custom (e.g. decoration-derived) badge shape.

path2.description: SVG path data filled with `color3`; may be empty.

groupDescription.description: Group description; absent from decorations sent with room socket events.

steam.description: Absent from decorations that are not Steam items.

UserBadgeInput.description: Badge submitted to `POST /api/user/badge`. Colors must be `#rrggbb`; `type` must be an integer 1-24 or exactly equal the caller's assigned custom badge paths, otherwise the server answers `invalid params`.

param.description: Numeric shape parameter -100..100. Servers coerce with JavaScript `Number()`/unary `+`, so numeric strings are accepted.

flip.description: Coerced to boolean by the server; defaults to false.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

branch.description: Source branch name. Empty/omitted, or a name that does not exist, falls back to `defaultModules` or `{main: ""}`.

newName.description: Target branch name. If the branch exists its modules are overwritten.

UserCodeBranch.description: Code branch document (`users.code`). node-screeps-api types only `_id`, `branch`, `activeWorld` and `activeSim`; complete documents also carry `user`, `modules` and `timestamp`.

activeWorld.description: Branch runs in the world. Absent on branches created by cloning until activated.

activeSim.description: Branch runs in the simulator. Absent on branches created by cloning until activated.

timestamp.description: Last code change as stored: Unix milliseconds for a branch last saved by `POST /api/user/code`, a date (ISO 8601 string) for one last saved by `POST /api/user/clone-branch` (both observed on screeps.com).

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

UserCodeModules.description: Code modules keyed by module name: JavaScript source text or `{binary}` WebAssembly. Servers drop module names starting with `$`, `.`, `/` or `\` and always ensure a `main` module exists.

branch.description: Branch name, or `$activeWorld` / `$activeSim` to select the branch active in the world / simulator. Empty or omitted selects `$activeWorld`.

_hash.description: Opaque client hash echoed in the `user:<id>/code` realtime event; the official web client compares it to recognize its own uploads.

hidden.description: True for memory edits, which do not echo in the console.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

data.description: Declared by node-screeps-api for memory writes; meaning undocumented.

UserConsoleQueuedResponse.description: Command queued. The body echoes the inserted console document and driver metadata (node-screeps-api shape; not a stable contract, rely on `ok`).

expression.description: JavaScript expression evaluated in the player runtime. JSON-encoded length must not exceed 1024 characters.

shard.description: Shard whose runtime evaluates the expression; the official web client sends the current shard and node-screeps-api refuses to call screeps.com without one.

cpu.description: CPU limit per shard name. Observed on screeps.com: the limits must total the account CPU; omitted shards count as 0.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

UserDbWriteResponse.description: Success; may include database driver `result` metadata (node-screeps-api `ScreepsDbUpdateResponse`).

UserDbWriteResult.description: Database driver write result echoed for some writes. Driver metadata, not a stable contract: clients should rely only on `ok`.

UserDecorationInstance.description: Decoration item owned by a player (screeps.com).

active.description: Values while active; `null` or absent when inactive.

label.description: Human-readable property name shown in the decoration editor.

default.description: Default value matching `type` (boolean, `#rrggbb`-style color string, number or string); `null` when unset. `range` defaults may be numeric strings.

min.description: `range` properties only: lower bound, a number or numeric string.

max.description: `range` properties only: upper bound, a number or numeric string.

step.description: `range` properties only: increment, a number or numeric string.

active.description: Values for the decoration's configurable `props` and, for room decorations, `shard` and `room`.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

theme.description: Theme id to draw from (raises the cost); empty string draws from any theme.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

branch.description: Branch to delete. Missing branches and branches active in world or simulator are silently kept.

email.description: New e-mail address; stored lower-cased and must be unused.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.
Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

data.description: `gz:` followed by base64 gzip of the JSON value at `path`. When the path cannot be traversed the literal string `Incorrect memory path` is returned instead (still a success body). Omitted when the value at `path` is undefined.

UserMemoryGetResponse.description: Memory value at the requested path.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

data.description: Segment text; `null` or absent for an uninitialized segment. screeps.com returns an array in request order when several comma-separated ids were requested.
Segment contents; at most 100 KiB after string conversion.

shard.description: Shard whose segment is written; the official web client sends the current shard and node-screeps-api refuses to call screeps.com without one.

path.description: Dot-separated Memory path (e.g. `creeps.Harvester1`). Empty/omitted replaces the whole Memory object.

value.description: JSON value to assign. Omitted deletes the value at `path`; with no `path`, every Memory key is deleted and an object value is merged in. Serialized size limit 1 MiB.

shard.description: Shard whose Memory is edited; the official web client sends the current shard and node-screeps-api refuses to call screeps.com without one.

memory.description: Whole Memory sent by a legacy official web client code path: arbitrary JSON (the bot's Memory). Server handling unverified.

UserMessage.description: One copy of a private message. Each send creates an `out` copy owned by the sender and an `in` copy owned by the recipient.

outMessage.description: On `in` copies: id of the sender's matching `out` copy.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

messages.description: Latest message of each conversation, newest first.

users.description: Public data of the listed respondents keyed by user id.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

messages.description: Latest 100 messages of the conversation, oldest first.

id.description: Id of an incoming (`in`) message owned by the caller.

0.description: Internal publish result (number of notified subscribers) merged into the body as `0` (node-screeps-api types a number).

1.description: Internal publish result (number of notified subscribers) merged into the body as `1` (node-screeps-api types a number).

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

UserMessagesMarkReadResponse.description: Success. The array of internal publish/update results is merged into the body under keys `0`-`2`; not a stable contract, rely on `ok`.

text.description: Message body, at most 100 KiB characters.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

UserMoneyHistoryMarketInfo.description: Transaction-specific details. Variants typed by node-screeps-api: price change (`changeOrderPrice`), extension (`extendOrder`), filled deal (resourceType/roomName/targetRoomName/owner/dealer/price/amount/npc) and new order (`order`).

dealer.description: User id that executed the deal.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

hasMore.description: True if a further page exists.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

disabledOnMessages.description: Do not notify about new private messages.

sendOnline.description: Send notifications even while the player is online (otherwise players seen in the last 10 minutes are skipped).

errorsInterval.description: Minutes between script error reports (100000 effectively disables them).

UserObjectDecoration.description: Non-badge decoration (screeps.com): creep, object, graffiti or landscape skin.

groupDescription.description: Group description; absent from decorations sent with room socket events.

steam.description: Absent from decorations that are not Steam items.

objectType.description: Room object type the decoration applies to (object decorations).

value.description: Statistic total in this time slot.

endTime.description: Slot index `ceil(ms / (interval minutes))`; monotonically increasing, not game time or a timestamp.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

statsMax.description: Largest slot value across the returned series (read by the official web client).

gameTimes.description: Shard game time at the start of the window (first element; node-screeps-api types the rest as undefined).

gcl.description: Lifetime control points (Global Control Level progress); absent if none.

power.description: Lifetime power processed (Global Power Level progress); absent if none.

steam.description: Linked Steam account, present only when the player has not hidden the profile link.

UserPublicSummary.description: Public `{_id, username, badge}` projection of a user, as embedded in `users` maps of message and leaderboard responses.

username.description: Absent for accounts that have not chosen a username.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

rooms.description: Rooms where the player may not place a new spawn (observed zero or one).

UserRoomStatValues.description: Sum of each room statistic over the window, keyed by statistic name. Known names: creepsLost, creepsProduced, energyConstruction, energyControl, energyCreeps, energyHarvested, powerProcessed.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

shards.description: Claimed room names keyed by shard.

reservations.description: Reserved room names keyed by shard, requested by the official web client with the `reservation` flag; node-screeps-api observes these arrays empty.

UserRoomsShardedResponse.description: Claimed and reserved rooms grouped by shard.

activeName.description: Activate in the world or the simulator.

visible.description: Truthy shows the Steam profile link in public profiles; falsy hides it.

UserStatInterval.description: Minutes per statistics slot: 8 (8 slots, about an hour), 180 (8 slots, a day), 1440 (daily slots; node-screeps-api describes 8 days).

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.
Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

timestamp.description: Server time of the change in Unix milliseconds.

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

items.description: Room name (`W5N5`) or, when no `shard` was requested, `shard/room` (e.g. `shard3/W5N5`).

room.description: Zero or one room names to center the map on.

UserWorldStatus.description: `empty`: no objects in the world (new or respawned, must place a spawn); `normal`: owns a spawn in a room whose controller it owns; `lost`: has objects but no such spawn (may respawn).

ok.description: Success marker; every JSON success body carries `ok: 1`.

UserDecorationActivation.description: Values of an active decoration: its configurable `props` keyed by property name (booleans, numbers, strings or `null`; list values are strings joined with `!SEP!`), plus `shard` and `room` for a decoration placed in a room.

shard.description: Shard of the room the decoration is placed in.

room.description: Room the decoration is placed in.
